name: Iarbanel

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Iarbanel is an Irish hero. He appears in the Book of Invasions, the legendary history of Ireland. The hero Nemed was his father. Iarbanel was the ancestor of the gods called the Tuatha Dé Danann. They are also called the tribe of the goddess Danu. From Starn, the brother of Iarbanel, came the Fir Bolg. The Fir Bolg were the enemies of the Tuatha Dé. The genealogy implies that Iarbanel may have been the consort of Danu. This is not clear. Danu is not linked with any god.
